The full-pool median is the most robust combination: it gives every model equal voice, is insensitive to the few outlier forecasts that would hurt a mean, and avoids the high-variance weight estimation that only 3 validation windows can support. All subset pools (5, 7, 9 models) and alternative combinations (mean, trimmed mean, DBA, weighted) scored worse, confirming that the breadth of the full pool plus the robustness of the median is the right strategy for this noisy, trend-dominated series.
